note: METADATA-ONLY SIDECAR -- there is NO value leaf for this list, deliberately (user, 2026-09-24: 'I might actually consider skipping most of the value-leaf and only doing the mulligan profile + metadata given that this isn't the final list'). This file exists ONLY to carry value_play, the mulligan-GENERATION contract that scripts/derive_mullgen_setting.py and scripts/mullgen_finalize.py write and src/analyzer/ExhaustiveKeep.cpp reads. It deliberately carries NO eval_model, no coefs and no trees.
why_this_is_inert_in_play: Two independent gates, both verified in source before this file was created. (1) EvalModelFromJsonObj (ai/MulliganProfileIO.h:1041) returns the EMPTY model when neither coefs nor trees is present -- 'never an all-zero active model that would silently re-tiebreak plans' -- so AttachValueSidecar attaches nothing that can rank a plan. (2) value_play.enabled defaults to FALSE (MulliganProfileIO.h:1227) and only an ENABLED block drives()/locks play (MulliganProfile.h:330,348); an unenabled block is 'a pure recommendation'. The loader parses a value_play holding only mull_gen_*/expected_buckets on purpose -- see the comment at MulliganProfileIO.h:1207, which describes exactly this file: 'phase F writes a value_play holding ONLY that key when the deck ships no play policy'. VERIFIED EMPIRICALLY, not just by reading: 600 games at seed 40000 depth 0 reproduce digest 1bc7de74e4cc896a, byte-identical to the same cell measured with no sidecar present at all.
NOT_an_adoption: Sidecar PRESENCE is what adopts a value LEAF, which is why a rejected model ships as <stem>.value.DISABLED.json. That rule is about the MODEL. This file has no model to adopt, so the DISABLED name would be wrong here -- it would hide the mull_gen contract from the generator that needs it. If a real value leaf is ever fitted for this list, it replaces this file wholesale.
